correctness.rationale: Eliminating velocity gives AR(2) with b=(1+a)^-2 and phi=[2(1+a)+a²(1-t)]/(1+a)², Gaussian innovation variance a³σ²/(1+a)^4. Jury conditions reduce exactly to Δ_t(a)>0 and t>0. The Yule–Walker covariance gives V_t=σ²(a²+2a+2)/(t(a+2)Δ_t). Independent symbolic derivative and factorization confirm F_t=B(a)[t-T(a)] and T'(a)=8(a+2)(a²-2a-2)(a²+2a+2)/[a²(a³+4a²+10a+8)²]. Thus T minimizes at a=1+√3, tc=(4+12√3)/13; each domain piece has claimed zero, one, or two extrema. Exact rational evaluation independently reproduces eleven-dimensional J'(1)=-10881433/143273691, J'(4)=40729/114967512, J'(20)=-2559661/557646408. This ensures total-error nonmonotonicity but not uniqueness of aggregate extrema.
